user.title: Connect to ZONT
user.description: Enter your ZONT server, API token and client contact email. Existing controller configuration is required. Feedback starts disabled.

reconfigure.title: Configure native ZONT connection
reconfigure.description: Enter credentials directly in HA. Leave token blank to keep an existing native token. Feedback starts disabled; stop any external feeder before enabling it in options.

assignment.title: Select existing configured sensors
assignment.description: Select a circuit already assigned to an external serial-zero virtual temperature sensor and a physical reserve. No controller configuration is created or changed.

sources.title: Select HA temperature sources
sources.description: Select any temperature entity, including BLE or Zigbee. Setup always starts with feedback disabled. Enable it later in options after stopping other feeders.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the HTTPS server address, token and contact email.
error.no_devices: No controllers were returned for this account.
error.configuration_required: The selected existing circuit, virtual sensor and reserve assignment is not ready.

abort.already_configured: This controller already has an entry.
abort.configuration_required: Configure an external serial-zero temperature sensor and a physical reserve in ZONT first.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Native connection updated. Feedback is disabled until explicitly enabled in options.

init.title: Temperature feedback
init.description: Stop any other feeder before enabling feedback. Physical fallback means stopping virtual injection; controller takeover is not proven by this selection. These settings are stored in HA; no helpers are required.

error.invalid_temperature: Select existing temperature entities with °C, °F or K units.
error.duplicate_source: Primary and fallback temperature entities must differ.

abort.reconfigure_required: Reconfigure this legacy companion entry with a ZONT server and token first.

state.heating_and_dhw: Heating and hot water with flame
state.both_without_flame: Heating and hot water modes without flame
state.flame_only: Flame without heating or hot water flag
